item.title: Sample Sermon Candidate 1
item.itunes:author: The River Church of Kansas City
item.description: How's everyone doing this morning? Hallelujah. Who came to give the Lord some praise this morning? Hallelujah. How many of you know that your praise is a weapon? That your worship is a weapon? Let's let our praise and our worship be a sweet smelling aroma to the Lord this morning. Amen? Let's praise. Good morning, River Church. How are we this morning? Amen. It is so good to see everybody after an amazing outreach

item.title: Sample Sermon Candidate 2
item.itunes:author: The River Church of Kansas City
item.description: River Church. Let's stand to our feet this morning. How many of you came ready to praise the Lord? Hallelujah. I feel a spirit of praise in this place this morning. Let me hear you give the Lord a shot of praise. Hallelujah. Come on. You can do better than that. This morning. Oh, hallelujah. Yes. Let's praise the Lord together. Place to be then the house of the Lord. Amen. The Bible says, I was glad, right, when I came to the house of the Lord. Amen. And today we can come. We can come and worship. We can come and praise. How awesome has it been this morning? How many of you have received?…
